decisions.reason: We keep the supportive insole because it fits our footwear and ergonomic know-how well, though it remains somewhat exposed to portfolio consolidation if it is not clearly differentiated from our other insole concepts.

We keep the ergonomic safety shoe series because it is tightly aligned with our core protective-footwear capabilities and the extra time on the market improves our ability to refine it rather than abandon it.

We keep the firefighter and rescue boots because they build on our established protection expertise in a related specialist field, even if the niche market makes them somewhat more vulnerable than our mainstream lines.

We keep the moulded insole because it was positioned as a flagship direction and draws directly on our fitting, development, and footwear knowledge, so we would invest in improving it before considering withdrawal.
